map.I 类阻断钠通道（按解离速度分 Ia/Ib/Ic），II 类阻断 β 受体，II: Class I blocks sodium channels (subdivided by dissociation kinetics into Ia, Ib and Ic), class II blocks beta receptors, class III prolongs repolarisation (potassium channels), and class IV blocks L-type calcium channels. The class determines which arrhythmias it suits and the proarrhythmic risk, and the choice must consider the underlying heart disease.
